compress_data: compress bytes data using arithmetic coding and a pretrained language model
decompress_data: decompress bytes data using arithmetic coding and a pretrained language model
compress_with_padded_bits: compress bytes data and return the number of padded bits for decoding
compress_lossless: compress bytes data using slow lossless compression for reversible decompression
retrieve_model_params: retrieve trained model parameters from params.npz file
